description: The survival HUD bars (P9c.core; catalog survival-needs; src/survival/survival-hud.ts), Godot hud.gd's behaviour as data. Ops: view {survival?, params?, staminaConfig?, state?, hud?, stamina?: {current, max}, now, visible} -> {visible, bars: [{id, label, value, max, fraction, band, tone, flash}]}; run {survival?, params?, staminaConfig?, visible?, start, steps: needs.json's run steps plus stamina (current, max, at) -> {state (the pool's), band (the bar's held band), events} and view (at)}; systems {request: a packs.compose request} -> {needs, stamina, running, worldActivation} (needs: pack survival-needs active in the composition; stamina: its activation lists module stamina; running: that activation; worldActivation: modules.activate over the world's list, for contrast), or {ok: false, refusal: {code, field: request}} when the composer refuses. Hidden (showSurvivalBars false): no bars. Bars in tuning order, then stamina from the pool's meter (fresh ok, winded warning, exhausted critical), held with hysteresis: a worse band at once, a better one only once the meter less the world's recoveryRate reaches it (never worse than the held band); a drop raises need_warning (Stamina is getting low) or need_critical (Stamina critically low!), a climb only need_restored (Stamina restored) into fresh, a climb from exhausted to winded nothing; the first reading raises nothing. tone: ok success, warning warning, critical danger. flash: the bar's latest need_warning / need_critical / need_restored kind while at <= now < at + hudFlashMs, else null; damage and need_satisfied do not flash. Runner: src/survival/systems-corpus.ts. Every case {name, op, input, expected}; compare exactly, object key sets included; an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip. Regenerate with npm run survival-corpus; npm run survival-corpus:check fails on any difference. See docs/survival-systems.md.

rules.staminaHysteresis: The stamina bar holds the band it last showed: it drops into a worse band at once and climbs out of a band only once the meter less one rest tick of recovery (the world's recoveryRate) is above that band's line, so one spend down and the next second's tick back cannot flap it (p9c-unreal m5). The margin is one tick because the flap is one tick: neither core nor the original engines had hysteresis.
rules.staminaWording: A drop into winded raises need_warning "Stamina is getting low", into exhausted need_critical "Stamina critically low!"; a climb raises only need_restored "Stamina restored", on reaching fresh. A climb from exhausted to winded raises nothing: the original game toasted only need_warning and need_critical and raised no warning on a climb, while Godot's need_warning there is what read wrongly.
rules.systems: What runs is the composer's activation (packs.compose), game-file choices included: survival-needs runs when the composition lists it active; stamina runs when the activation lists module stamina; the header lists that activation as running and every other module as off. modules.activate over the world's list is the same answer only when the game makes no choices, and is not read beside a composition (p9c-unreal m4; src/survival/survival-systems.ts).

openQuestions: The hysteresis margin is pinned at one rest tick (recoveryRate points); whether a world should author its own margin is open (needs_ruling if wanted).

What a host with no composition (the composer refused, or a packaged build without the pack catalogue) lists in its header: P10's packaging question (p9c-unreal m3), not this rule. Neither survival system runs then.

cases.name: view: hidden unless the world opts in (showSurvivalBars): no bars
view: Godot's labels, fractions, tones by band; the stamina bar last, from the pool's meter and its winded band
view: authored stamina thresholds decide the stamina bar's band; a meter with no max reads 0 and ok
view: a fraction clamps into 0..1 when a reading lies outside [0, max]
view: a stamina meter with max 0
view: a flash shows from its event until hudFlashMs after it, and not before it
run: warning, critical, restored: the tone follows the band and each change flashes for hudFlashMs
run: stamina spent into winded and exhausted flashes the stamina bar; rest back out flashes restored
run: a damage tick and a need_satisfied restore change no band, so neither flashes
run: a hidden HUD draws nothing and the needs still run

run: stamina hysteresis: a jump across the exhausted line and the next second's rest tick back do not flap; the bar leaves exhausted only a whole rest tick (recoveryRate 5) above 15%, silently, and says restored at fresh
run: the winded line holds the same way: winded is left only above 40% plus one rest tick; a drop is shown at once
run: a climb out of exhausted straight past winded is one restored; a world recoveryRate of 0 leaves no margin
run: the first stamina reading raises no event and sets the held band; a bar with no max reads ok
systems: no game choices: the composer's activation is the world's own list (modules.activate); neither survival system runs

systems: a game file switching survival-needs on runs it and stamina (its dependency); the composer's activation gains stamina while the world's own list does not, so the header lists stamina as running (p9c-unreal m4)
systems: the world's own list names stamina and the game makes no choice: stamina runs, survival-needs does not
systems: a game switching survival-needs on where inventory does not run: survival-needs is refused (requires-inactive) and does not run, while stamina, started as its dependency, does
systems: a request the composer refuses has no composition, so nothing is read from it
